points.description: Convolutional layer(s) with kernels/filters that convolve over the input image (to extract features), followed by an activation layer such as ReLU.
points.partial_credit: Half marks if only the convolutional layer or only the activation is mentioned.

points.description: Pooling layer (max or average pooling) to downsample the feature maps.
One or more fully connected layers.
Final softmax (output) layer producing class probabilities.
